mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_info SET last_login_ip=#{params.ip}, last_login_time=#{params.date}, login_count=(COALESCE(login_count,0)+1) WHERE uid=#{params.uid}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(COALESCE ( sm.data_scope, 0 )) AS dataScope,m.menu_code AS permissionsCode FROM sys_role_menu sm INNER JOIN sys_role_user sr ON sr.role_id = sm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON sm.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE sr.user_id=#{userId} AND m.menu_code!='' GROUP BY m.menu_code

SELECT du.user_id FROM sys_department_user du WHERE 1 = 1
AND du.department_id IN
#{dept}
GROUP BY du.user_id
SELECT du.department_id FROM sys_department_user du WHERE du.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY du.department_id

SELECT sui.uid, sui.user_name, sd."id" AS deptId, sd."name" AS deptName, sui.user_state as userState FROM sys_user_info sui LEFT JOIN sys_department_user sdu ON sdu.user_id = sui.uid LEFT JOIN sys_department sd ON sd."id" = sdu.department_id where sui.user_type = 'erp'

SELECT sui.uid userId, sui.code, sui.email, sui.mobile, sui.real_name, sui.user_account, sui.user_name, sr."id" roleId, sr.role_name from sys_user_info sui LEFT JOIN sys_role_user sru on sui.uid = sru.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr on sr."id" = sru.role_id where sui.user_type = 'erp' and sr.id in
#{roleId}

select uid as userId,user_name as userName,delete_state as userState from ( select sui.uid, sui.user_name, sui.delete_state from sys_user_info sui where sui.delete_state = 1 and sui.user_type='erp'
and ((sui.uid = #{params.searchKeyword}) or sui.user_name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when sui.user_name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when sui.user_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when sui.user_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , sui.user_name,
sui.user_name asc,
uid desc ) userInfo
